name: Meta Gray-Scott coral worms
description: From the metaGrayScott search (#43): F raised regionally where b has been (reach 28, memory 40k steps), while k and D_a are raised in narrow trails (reach ~1, memory 6.7k). Branching worms that keep rebuilding a coral-like web; ran 120k steps without settling. Tint = the D_a field. Try: Explore… with the gains unlocked, or raise Da_gain towards 2 for faster, looser growth.
